mintAuthority.summary: Operational KESm issuance runs through the Mento Broker, which burns the incoming Mento stable token and mints the outgoing token during USDm/KESm swaps. StableTokenV2 also authorizes the Celo ValidatorsProxy, but its current implementation only mints registry USDm for EpochManager; its Celo-Governance-owned proxy is therefore a latent upgrade-controlled KESm mint surface. exchange() is zero, and the two-day Mento Timelock can change token authorization slots and upgrade the KESm token and Broker. D14: issuance is economically unbounded because the token owner can set an arbitrary Broker/minter with no token-level collateral check; the two-day delay does not bound the amount. D29 is not certified because the authorized Validators proxy has separate Celo Governance upgrade authority.

controls.label: Mento Broker - operational KESm swap minter
controls.capDescription: Broker swap issuance is constrained by registered exchange-provider execution and per-exchange/per-token trading-limit checks in guardTradingLimits. The Broker owner can configure those limits through configureTradingLimit; the observed owner is the 172800-second Mento Timelock. These are configurable flow limits, not an immutable total-supply ceiling; no current numeric limit is asserted.
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, broker() on KESm returned this Broker. Broker swaps call transferIn to burn the incoming Mento stable and transferOut to mint the outgoing stable only through registered exchanges subject to exchange and trading-limit checks.

controls.label: Mento Timelock - KESm token and Broker administrator
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, KESm owner(), token proxy owner, and Broker proxy owner returned this Timelock; getMinDelay() returned 172800 seconds. StableTokenV2 ownership can change broker, validators, and exchange authorization slots, while the proxy role can replace token and Broker mint-critical logic.

controls.label: Celo ValidatorsProxy - authorized KESm minter slot
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, validators() on KESm returned this proxy and StableTokenV2 admitted it through onlyMinter. The current Validators implementation can mint only Registry USDm to EpochManager and has no generic or KESm-targeting call, so the slot is authorized but cannot currently issue KESm.

controls.label: Celo GovernanceProxy - Validators proxy upgrade owner
controls.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, ValidatorsProxy _getOwner() returned this GovernanceProxy and _getImplementation() returned 0x13B0B89F3242f815C1FC6C9CF56e1Ab5aEA4dC58. Governance can change the authorized proxy's implementation, creating a latent KESm mint path, but has no current direct KESm call.

review.evidence: At finalized Celo block 72780426, KESm broker(), owner(), validators(), and exchange() returned the Mento Broker, two-day Mento Timelock, Celo ValidatorsProxy, and zero address respectively. Proxy introspection resolved the current token and Broker implementations and administrators. The Broker is the live swap mint/burn path; the current Validators implementation can only mint Registry USDm, while its Celo-Governance-owned proxy remains a latent upgrade-controlled authorization surface. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: Mento administration is delayed two days or controlled by Celo governance, the live shared-reserve feed covers the reserve basket, and no regulator or independent attestor is evidenced. D14/D29 review 2026-10-03 at Celo block 79142378 (hash 0xe5ac3917c420c5f097992356e3a8934c336d354a139b8a1207fe547af3569c6c): owner(), _getOwner(), and the EIP-1967 admin slot resolve to Mento Timelock 0x890db8a597940165901372dd7db61c9f246e2147, not the migration Safe; the implementation slot resolves to verified StableTokenV2 0x434563b0604be100f04b7ae485bcafe3c9d8850e. Read-only setBroker(0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead) from that owner succeeds, and mint(chosenRecipient,1e18) from the configured Broker succeeds. Verified setBroker accepts an arbitrary address; onlyMinter gates mint by caller identity and imposes no collateral/deposit check or economic ceiling. The 172800-second Timelock delay does not make arbitrary minter authorization economically bounded. D29 screening confirms MentoGovernor proposer/canceller membership, open execution, Timelock administration, and no such Safe roles; the separately observed canceller 0xe6951c4176aab41097c6f5fe11e9c515b7108acd is not asserted to have mint power. The governor uses the verified lock-escrowed veMENTO contract. However validators() on this token resolves to 0xaeb865bca93ddc8f47b8e29f40c5399ce34d0c58, whose proxy owner is separate Celo Governance 0xd533ca259b330c7a88f74e000a3faea2d63b7972: independently replacing this token-authorized implementation is not rooted in MentoGovernor. Current Validators targets registry USDm, not this token; that observation does not close its independent upgrade path. Complete governor-only issuance closure is therefore not certified and no governedIssuance or complete executionScope is authored. This D14 verdict supersedes any earlier raiseable/partially-bounded economic inference; reconciliation and supervision are unchanged.
